name: scenario_0674
description: The user is organizing their music library based on data visualizations and sharing some movie trivia they found. (UI mode)

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3, image_4, image_5, image_6]
Query: Create a new playlist called 'Joyful Tunes'. Look at the radar charts in this sixth image and compare the 'joy' levels of the artists. I think Billie Eilish has the highest joy, so add one of her songs to the playlist. Also, compare the box office revenues of 'Barbie' and 'Oppenheimer' in the third image here, and send an email to movies@example.com stating which movie earned more.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a playlist called 'Joyful Tunes'. Direct its attention to the radar charts in the last image, specifically looking at the 'joy' metric. State that you think Billie Eilish has the highest joy level, and ask it to add one of her songs to the playlist. Then, ask it to look at the third image, compare the box office revenues of 'Barbie' and 'Oppenheimer', and send an email to movies@example.com stating which of the two earned more. If the assistant correctly points out that Billie Eilish does not actually have the highest joy level, acknowledge it but tell it to go ahead with your instruction for now and that you'll fix it later. Just make sure the email is sent and the playlist is created. Once the actions are complete, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2
Query: You were right about the joy levels, my mistake! Remove the Billie Eilish song from 'Joyful Tunes' and replace it with a song by the correct artist from that sixth image — I'll pick once you identify them. Then, look at the fourth image with the Beatles albums. Compare the number of 'Top 50 playable songs' — the white stars — on 'Help!' and 'Revolver'. I want to add one of those albums to my Spotify library — I'll decide which.
Instructions: Acknowledge your mistake about the joy levels. Ask the assistant to remove the Billie Eilish song from the 'Joyful Tunes' playlist and present which artist actually has the highest joy level in the sixth image's radar charts. When the assistant identifies the correct artist, confirm adding a song by that artist (BTS / Dynamite) via `ui_user_interact`. Then, ask the assistant to compare the white stars on 'Help!' and 'Revolver' in the fourth image. When it presents the counts, select the album with more Top 50 playable songs (Revolver) and add it to your library via `ui_user_interact`. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant to add BTS and Revolver. If the assistant miscounts the stars or selects the wrong artist, point it back to the respective images. Once both Spotify tasks are complete, conclude the conversation.

You have 6 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.

task_completion_criteria:
Create a Spotify playlist named 'Joyful Tunes' containing a song by BTS, send an email to movies@example.com stating that Barbie earned more at the box office than Oppenheimer (or something similar expressing the same idea), and add the Beatles album 'Revolver' to the user's Spotify library.

UI Requirements:
- Round 2: The agent must present the joy level analysis from the radar charts in a structured interactive UI that lets the user confirm the correct artist to add. The agent must also present the Top 50 playable songs comparison between Help! and Revolver in a structured interactive UI that lets the user select which album to add to their library.
